description: Compute the end-of-service gratuity (UAE Art. 51: 21 days' basic wage per year for 5 years then 30, capped at 2 years' wage, pro rata, unpaid days excluded) or the Saudi award (Art. 84/85/87: half a month's actual wage per year for 5 years then a full month, resignation fractions ⅓/⅔/full). Returns the step-by-step computation. Example: country 'AE', start_date '2019-03-01', end_date '2026-10-31', basic_monthly_wage 8000, termination 'resignation'.  Response: result with legal_basis (article) and explanation[] steps, data_confidence (high = official text; medium = translation or recent amendment via secondary source), estimated_items[], sources[] (law URLs), data_version, warnings[] and a not-legal-advice disclaimer.
